# Create test_m3.py
test_m3 = '''"""Tests for milestone m3: VersionInfo.__getitem__"""

def test_getitem_exists():
    import semver
    assert hasattr(semver.VersionInfo, "__getitem__")
    assert callable(getattr(semver.VersionInfo, "__getitem__"))


def test_getitem_positive_indices():
    import semver
    v = semver.VersionInfo.parse("1.2.3-rc.1+build.2")
    assert v[0] == 1
    assert v[1] == 2
    assert v[2] == 3
    assert v[3] == "rc.1"
    assert v[4] == "build.2"


def test_getitem_negative_index():
    import semver
    v = semver.VersionInfo.parse("1.2.3-rc.1+build.2")
    assert v[-1] == "build.2"
    assert v[-2] == "rc.1"
    assert v[-3] == 3
    assert v[-4] == 2
    assert v[-5] == 1


def test_getitem_slice():
    import semver
    v = semver.VersionInfo.parse("1.2.3-rc.1+build.2")
    assert v[1:3] == (2, 3)
    assert v[0:2] == (1, 2)
    assert v[2:] == (3, "rc.1", "build.2")
    assert v[:3] == (1, 2, 3)


def test_getitem_out_of_range_raises():
    import semver
    import pytest
    v = semver.VersionInfo.parse("1.2.3-rc.1+build.2")
    with pytest.raises(IndexError):
        _ = v[5]
    with pytest.raises(IndexError):
        _ = v[-6]


def test_getitem_uses_to_tuple():
    """Verify that __getitem__ internally calls to_tuple()."""
    import semver

    class TrackedVersion(semver.VersionInfo):
        to_tuple_call_count = 0

        def to_tuple(self):
            TrackedVersion.to_tuple_call_count += 1
            return super().to_tuple()

    v = TrackedVersion.parse("1.2.3-rc.1+build.2")
    TrackedVersion.to_tuple_call_count = 0
    _ = v[0]
    assert TrackedVersion.to_tuple_call_count >= 1
'''

with open('crucible_hidden/test_m3.py', 'w') as f:
    f.write(test_m3)

print("Created test_m3.py")
